label: pipeline_idle
title: Versioned processing
body: Receipt acceptance commits Admission synchronously. Later Review, Score and Settle use worker leases; immutable bundle identity belongs to each run.

label: pipeline_pending
title: Processing is pending
body: A run awaits its next Review, Score or Settle phase. Phase commits reset charged attempts. Receipt acceptance and human assessment can create pending work independently of worker responses.

label: pipeline_leased
title: Worker phase lease
body: Two workers retain separate request snapshots. Expiry permits reclaim; a late result checks token and database-clock lease. Bounded renewal differs from the exclusive human review claim.

label: pipeline_review_hold
title: Privacy and Review hold
body: The Review-start classifier records a privacy pass before Review. Escalation or Admission quarantine parks the run without charging its claim; a live human claim and phase-bound assessment resolve the hold.

label: pipeline_score_hold
title: Score review hold
body: The Score policy requested human review before pricing. No award or settlement is seeded. Rejection produces a server zero Score; approval is passed into the policy, and a repeated hold fails terminally.

label: pipeline_retry
title: Retry or suspension
body: Operational failures spend a finite attempt budget. Missing controls, dependency outages, policy suspension and transient failures return the claim attempt and remain retryable with a bounded delay.

label: pipeline_settle
title: Settlement progress boundary
body: Persisted selection, terminal instrument progress and a paid leg are distinct from the phase commit. Detailed index, credit and payout effects are owned by server_settlement.

label: pipeline_operator_hold
title: Paid run needs an operator
body: A finishable Settle run with a paid leg can park when its gate commit is refused permanently. An operator may fail it or grant another commit attempt; a released paid run can be held again.

label: pipeline_terminal
title: Processing ended
body: Complete and Failed remain distinct in the run record. Review rejection and Admission rejection complete normally. Exhaustion and deterministic refusal can fail, while paid-leg holds retain their separate state.
